agent_explanation: Energy is stable ~493 J for steps 0-3 while approaching wall. At step 4 body collides with wall box at (8.9,2.8). Despite restitution 0.936 <1 and no controller work, speed increases from 30.8 to 33.29 and total energy jumps from 493.05 to 573.49 J (+80 J). This indicates bug in wall collision impulse for corner/side impact: likely double-counted impulse or over-correction adding energy instead of removing. Lowering restitution to 0 removes gain, confirming collision restitution path.
